script: (()=>{ const path=document.getElementById('ecg-line'); const width=1200; const center=60; let d=`M 0 ${center}`; let x=0; while (x < width){ // Pequena oscilação natural const baselineLength=35 + Math.random() * 45; for (let i=0; i < baselineLength; i +=5){ const y=center + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2; d +=` L ${x + i} ${y}`;} x +=baselineLength; // Batimento ocasional if (Math.random() >0.45){ d +=` L ${x + 8} ${center} L ${x + 15} ${center - 8} L ${x + 22} ${center + 4} L ${x + 29} ${center - 42} L ${x + 36} ${center + 28} L ${x + 45} ${center} `; x +=45;}} path.setAttribute('d', d); // Animação suave const length=path.getTotalLength(); path.style.strokeDasharray=length; path.style.strokeDashoffset=length; path.animate( [ { strokeDashoffset: length}, { strokeDashoffset: 0} ], { duration: 12000, iterations: Infinity, easing: 'linear'} )})();
